The discriminating dimensions are quality_mean / reached_rate (not raw cost). REQUIRES the fixtures: create with the EXP-001 fixture writer; remove with `rm ~/.claude/projects/-home-shumway-projects-CorvinOS/memory/bench-cel-*.md`. All facts are synthetic and PII-free (ADR-0297).
